description: Reduced grants and reporting-subscription coverage (experimental media_buy.reporting_subscriptions, AdCP 3.3). Revocation means no access (adcp#8607): a seller that wants a buyer to finish reconciling keeps a reduced grant instead of revoking. Coverage follows the grant: an account is covered while its authorization, when advertised, lists get_reporting_status in allowed_tasks. A grant without get_reporting_status reads exactly as a loss of authority at the instant it took effect.
rule: covered = authorization is absent, or authorization.allowed_tasks lists get_reporting_status. read_only does not affect coverage.

grant_cases.name: no authorization object: restricts no task
reduced grant without get_reporting_status: receipts and statuses only
reduced grant without get_reporting_status: statuses only
reduced grant without get_reporting_status: buying tasks only

transition_conventions.offering: One delivery offering: period_duration P1D, alignment utc, delivery_sla PT0S, feed_purpose analytics, finality snapshot, delivery_only.
transition_conventions.subscription: analytics-daily version 1, scope all_authorized_accounts, accepted at 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z.
transition_conventions.buy: mb-1 on account-a, confirmed 2026-09-01T06:00:00Z, flight 2026-09-02T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-11T00:00:00Z, one package mapped to the offering.
transition_conventions.grant: authorized_at 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z. Each step replaces the account's authorization at its instant; the seller reconciles at that instant and the revocation instant is the observation time. allowed_tasks null means an authorization that restricts no task; revoked means the account leaves the list.
transition_conventions.expected: Read at evaluate_at: authorized is the engine's current authority, covered is whether get_reporting_status shows the subscription on the account, unauthorized_at lists accounts_unauthorized for account-a, owed lists every owed period start in order.

transition_cases.name: wind-down keeps coverage and opens no accounts_unauthorized entry
a reduced grant without get_reporting_status ends coverage like a revocation
a reduced grant without get_reporting_status owes the same periods as a full revocation
dropping get_reporting_status from a wind-down grant ends coverage then
restoring get_reporting_status inside retention is a re-grant with a gap
